content.user_title: Detect LLM Prompt Regressions with Promptfoo
content.value_statement: Prompt changes can silently reduce output quality. This skill builds golden datasets, runs Promptfoo evaluations, and summarizes failures and recent trends.
actual_capabilities: Initializes a Promptfoo directory, golden dataset folder, configuration file, and results ignore rule.
Captures named test cases with system prompts, user inputs, expected behavior, and optional variables.
Runs Promptfoo evaluations without cache and stores timestamped local result files.
Reports total, passed, and failed cases with assertion details and duration.
Summarizes pass rates and new failures across the five most recent evaluations.
limitations: Requires the Promptfoo CLI, provider access, and any credentials required by the configured model.
The generated configuration targets one Anthropic model and uses general rubric assertions.
Trend reports cover only the five most recent local evaluation files.
Shell examples assume a Unix environment with common command-line utilities.

use_cases.title: Validate prompt changes
use_cases.description: Compare updated prompts against recorded expectations before merging code changes.

use_cases.title: Check model migrations
use_cases.description: Rerun a stable golden dataset after changing a model or provider version.

use_cases.title: Enforce release quality
use_cases.description: Run prompt evaluations in continuous integration and stop releases when assertions fail.

prompt_templates.title: Initialize a test suite
prompt_templates.prompt: Initialize Promptfoo regression testing in this repository. Show the files created and explain any prerequisites that are missing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Starting a golden dataset in an existing project

prompt_templates.title: Add a golden case
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a golden test named {name}. Ask for the system prompt, user input, expected behavior, and optional variables before writing it.

prompt_templates.title: Run regression tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Run all golden prompt tests. Summarize the pass rate, duration, and each failed assertion with expected and actual behavior.
prompt_templates.scenario: Checking a prompt change before merge

prompt_templates.title: Analyze release trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the last five evaluations, identify new failures, compare pass-rate trends, and recommend quality gates for {release_workflow}.

output_examples.input: Initialize regression testing for this prompt project.
output_examples.output: Initialized the Promptfoo configuration and golden dataset directory. The results directory is ignored, and the suite is ready for its first case.

output_examples.input: Run the golden tests after my system prompt change.
output_examples.output: Regression results: 12 total, 11 passed, and 1 failed. The auth-flow case failed its expected behavior rubric and needs review.
Recent trend: four of five runs passed completely. One auth-flow failure appeared in the latest run, so quality is declining.

best_practices: Review every golden case before committing it, and exclude prompts containing secrets or sensitive data.
Describe expected behavior precisely enough that rubric assertions produce consistent results.
Run the suite after prompt or model changes and before every release.
anti_patterns: Do not treat one current model response as a permanent definition of correct behavior.
Do not commit API keys, private prompts, personal data, or confidential outputs in golden files.
Do not ignore unstable rubric failures without reviewing the assertion and provider behavior.

faq.question: What must be installed?
faq.answer: Install the Promptfoo CLI and configure access for the model provider used by the evaluation.

faq.question: Which files does the skill create?
faq.answer: It creates Promptfoo configuration, golden YAML cases, local result files, and a results entry in .gitignore.

faq.question: Can these tests run in continuous integration?
faq.answer: Yes. Run the Promptfoo evaluation in continuous integration and fail the job when an assertion fails.

faq.question: Should sensitive prompts be stored as golden cases?
faq.answer: No. Keep sensitive cases outside the repository and avoid storing credentials or confidential content.

faq.question: Can I use a different model?
faq.answer: Yes. Edit the generated Promptfoo provider configuration before running the suite.

faq.question: How much evaluation history is reported?
faq.answer: The report summarizes the five most recent timestamped result files available in the local results directory.
